description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Izzet Boilerworks.
